The softness or fertility of the earth symbolizes the nurturing qualities of the great mother Goddess Earth. Additionally, the root word 'Riju' meaning 'earth' can be interpreted as a reminder of the grounding or grounded feeling that one should maintain in their spiritual journey. Ultimately, the name Rijul may evoke a deep sense of reverence for the natural world and serve as an inspiration to live in harmony and peace with all beings on earth.
